messages:
anya: quick sync 1: I have a docs PR that must be merged before the release branch cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4377
liz: which cut are we targeting?
mike: v2.1 cut is 2026-04-15 20:00 UTC. any PRs touching /v2.1 need landing ~3h before to allow preview + editorial.
anya: thanks 1: can we aim for 17:30 UTC merge? that gives us 2.5h for preview + last spellcheck.
sam: I can do the smoke tests at 16:45 UTC. what's failing on CI?
docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4377 1: link-check: failed (1 broken anchor), lint: ok.
anya: I updated an anchor id in the migration guide but missed an internal ref. pushing fix now.
liz: also note: the SDK snippet should use the new async client shape to avoid confusing users. Suggest updating example to:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-2', prompt: 'hello' })
```
mike: we should include a short compatibility note for legacy client users (1 sentence + link to legacy snippet).
anya: adding compatibility blurb under "SDK migration" heading. pushing in 1 commit.
sam: quick check 16:45: I'll run the snippet, check /v2.1 nav, and run link-check locally.
docs-ci-bot: New preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4377 1: link-check: pass, lint: warn (line-length in example).
anya: great. @liz @mike 1: can we merge at 17:30 UTC? mike said he'll handle the merge, pls do not squash (we need separate commits for the anchor fix + example change).
mike: 17:30 ok. I'll merge with merge-commit and watch for conflicts with release branch.
liz: LGTM after the preview shows pass and compatibility note present.
sam: +1. I'll post smoke results at 16:50.
release-bot: Reminder 1: release branch cut scheduled 2026-04-15 20:00 UTC. PRs merged after this time will target main and require manual backport to release branch.
anya: noted. Also flag: this PR updates versioned docs (/v2.1) 1: keep history (no squash) for easier backport if needed.
mike: will merge with merge commit. if conflicts appear, I'll coordinate with release lead.
liz: follow-up task: add a docs-ci test for presence of /v2.1 nav entry. filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/227
anya: thanks all 1: will update this thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
